parent: Frozen original Stage1 39 primary inputs and fixed 0bp beta-composition own-state account; SOXX remains final benchmark. Attribution only, no new strategy selection.
method: Join all 944 funded original Stage1 signal dates to original Qlib Recorder inputs. Transform exact original 39 features with frozen training scalers, then summarize each complete/partial trade-date quarter without selecting dates. Join candidate own-account target, ending holdings, risk state and SOXX quarter-relative wealth only after all feature rows are fixed. Highlight 2024Q3 and 2026Q3 as pre-existing examples from beta-composition attribution, not as trading-rule training labels.
output: Full quarter x feature matrix and daily joined data in one native Qlib Recorder; compact all-quarter financial/feature summary and Chinese conclusion in card.
limits: A retrospective contrast does not prove feature causal value or prospective tradability
Endogenous risk states and holdings cannot be used as exogenous market regimes
Do not choose a threshold, sign, interval or model from this attribution
